Code blocks, Bash commands and Write previews keep their blank lines, and `markdown` fences are drawn as rendered Markdown.

- Claude Code's code view draws an empty line with no height, so blank lines inside fenced code blocks, Bash command cards and Write content cards disappeared and paragraphs ran together. desk-look now passes them as a single space
- A ```` ```markdown ```` or ```` ```md ```` fence (an issue or MR draft, say) is drawn rendered inside its border: headings, tables, lists, bold. The copy button still copies the raw source
- desk-asana and desk-slack share desk-look's Markdown renderer, so a `markdown` fence in an Asana task note or comment, or in a Slack message, is drawn rendered too, and their code blocks keep blank lines
- desk-review: the source shown under a review item keeps its blank lines, so rows line up with their line numbers again
- desk-review: each item is grouped by a bar in its status colour, the file name stands out from its folder, reasons are no longer dimmed, and code sits in a box with long lines cut instead of wrapping under the line numbers
- desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.73.1 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
